# Setup

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(ggthemes)
library(mclogit)
library(nnet)
library(parameters)
library(DirichletReg) 
```

# Compiling datasets 

Trajectory level

```{r}
loadData <- function(path, group, model) {
  df <- read.csv(path)
  df$group <- group # Keeping track of experimental condition 
  df$model <- model # Keeping track of model zero-shot or fine-tuned 
  df
}

control_low  <- loadData("control_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "zero_shot") 
control_medium    <- loadData("control_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "zero_shot")
control_random   <- loadData("control_random/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "random", "zero_shot")
control_deceptive   <- loadData("control_deceptive/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "deceptive", "zero_shot")

avoid_low         <- loadData("avoid_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")
avoid_medium      <- loadData("avoid_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")

ft_control_low    <- loadData("ft_control_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_control_medium <- loadData("ft_control_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_low      <- loadData("ft_avoid_low/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_medium   <- loadData("ft_avoid_medium/coin_per_trajectory.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")


full_data <- rbind(
  control_low, control_medium, control_random, control_deceptive,
  avoid_low, avoid_medium,
  ft_control_low, ft_control_medium, ft_avoid_low, ft_avoid_medium
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    coin_and_goal = as.integer(reached_goal + coin_collected == 2),
    goal_only = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 1 & coin_collected == 0, 1, 0)),
    coin_only = as.integer(ifelse(reached_goal == 0 & coin_collected == 1, 1, 0)),
    grid_size = as.factor(grid_size),
    density = as.factor(density)
  )

rm(control_low, control_medium, control_random, control_deceptive, 
   avoid_low, avoid_medium,
   ft_control_low, ft_control_medium, ft_avoid_low, ft_avoid_medium)

head(full_data)
```

Grid level

```{r}
control_low_grid  <- loadData("control_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "zero_shot") 
control_medium_grid    <- loadData("control_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "zero_shot")
control_random_grid   <- loadData("control_random/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "random", "zero_shot")
control_deceptive_grid   <- loadData("control_deceptive/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "deceptive", "zero_shot")
avoid_low_grid         <- loadData("avoid_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")
avoid_medium_grid      <- loadData("avoid_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "zero_shot")
ft_control_low_grid    <- loadData("ft_control_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_control_medium_grid <- loadData("ft_control_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "control", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_low_grid      <- loadData("ft_avoid_low/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")
ft_avoid_medium_grid   <- loadData("ft_avoid_medium/coin_trajectory_metrics.csv", "avoid", "fine_tuned")
full_data_grid <- rbind(
  control_low_grid, control_medium_grid, control_random_grid, control_deceptive_grid,
  avoid_low_grid, avoid_medium_grid,
  ft_control_low_grid, ft_control_medium_grid, ft_avoid_low_grid, ft_avoid_medium_grid
  ) 
rm(control_low_grid, control_medium_grid, control_random_grid, control_deceptive_grid, 
   avoid_low_grid, avoid_medium_grid,
   ft_control_low_grid, ft_control_medium_grid, ft_avoid_low_grid, ft_avoid_medium_grid)
head(full_data_grid)
```

Subsetting data for this specific round of analyses 

```{r}
traj_df <- full_data %>% 
  filter(!trajectory_category %in% c("random_starts","reshuffled_walls"),
         group %in% c("control","random"), model == "zero_shot", reasoning_effort %in% c("low","medium","random")) %>%
  mutate( # Ordering factors for mdl fitting 
    trajectory_category = fct_relevel(trajectory_category, "base"),
    grid_size = factor(grid_size,
                       levels = c("7", "9", "11"),
                       labels = c("Grid size 7", "Grid size 9", "Grid size 11"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
    density = factor(density,
                     levels = c("0","0.2","0.4","0.6"),
                     ordered = TRUE)
  )

grid_df <- full_data_grid %>%
  filter(!trajectory_category %in% c("random_starts","reshuffled_walls"),
         group %in% c("control","random"), model == "zero_shot", reasoning_effort %in% c("low","medium","random")) %>%
  mutate( # Ordering factors for mdl fitting 
    trajectory_category = fct_relevel(trajectory_category, "base"),
    grid_size = factor(grid_size,
                       levels = c("7", "9", "11"),
                       labels = c("Grid size 7", "Grid size 9", "Grid size 11"),
                       ordered = TRUE),
    density = factor(density,
                     levels = c("0","0.2","0.4","0.6"),
                     ordered = TRUE)
  )

file_output <- "one_coin_medium"
```

# Success

```{r}
grid_success_summary <- traj_df %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, reasoning_effort) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(coin_and_goal),
    se   = sd(coin_and_goal) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

grid_success_raw <- traj_df %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, grid_key, reasoning_effort) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(coin_and_goal),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p1 <- ggplot(grid_success_summary,
             aes(x = factor(density), y = mean, fill = reasoning_effort)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = grid_success_raw,
    aes(x = factor(density), y = mean, fill = reasoning_effort),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.1, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ grid_size) +
  scale_fill_manual(
  values = c(low    = "#2c6fb0",
             medium = "#7aa8d4",
             random = "#b0b0b0"),
  labels = c(low    = "Low reasoning",
             medium = "Medium reasoning",
             random = "Random actions")
) +
  labs(x = "Density", y = "Task success", fill = "Model") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

p1

ggsave(
  file.path("figures", file_output, "success_plot.png"),
  p1, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 600
)
```

```{r}
# Low and medium vs random 
success_mdl1 <- traj_df %>%
  mutate(reasoning_effort = relevel(factor(reasoning_effort), ref = "random")) %>%
  glmer(
    coin_and_goal ~ reasoning_effort + grid_size + density + (1 | grid_key),
    data = .,
    family = binomial(),
    control = glmerControl(optimizer='bobyqa')
  )

summary(success_mdl1)

exp(cbind(OR = fixef(success_mdl1),
          confint(success_mdl1, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")))
```

# Accuracy and uncertainty 

```{r}
# --- 1. Rename columns to a consistent measure_phase pattern -----------------
metrics_renamed <- grid_df %>%
  rename(
    accuracy_overall         = mean_action_accuracy,
    accuracy_phase1          = mean_action_accuracy_phase1,
    accuracy_phase2          = mean_action_accuracy_phase2,
    entropy_overall         = mean_entropy,
    entropy_phase1          = mean_entropy_phase1,
    entropy_phase2          = mean_entropy_phase2,
    jsd_overall             = mean_jsd,
    jsd_phase1              = mean_jsd_phase1,
    jsd_phase2              = mean_jsd_phase2,
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    grid_size = factor(grid_size),
    density   = factor(density)
  )

# --- 2. Reshape to long format, keeping every raw row (for jitter) ----------
metrics_long_raw <- metrics_renamed %>%
  select(grid_size, density,
         accuracy_overall, accuracy_phase1, accuracy_phase2, 
         entropy_overall,        entropy_phase1,        entropy_phase2,
         jsd_overall,            jsd_phase1,            jsd_phase2) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(grid_size, density),
    names_to = c("measure", "phase"),
    names_pattern = "(accuracy|entropy|jsd|optimalentropy)_(overall|phase1|phase2)",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    measure = factor(measure,
                      levels = c("accuracy", "entropy", "jsd", "optimalentropy"),
                      labels = c("Accuracy", "Entropy", "JSD", "Optimal Entropy")),
    phase   = factor(phase, levels = c("overall", "phase1", "phase2"),
                      labels = c("Overall", "Coin", "Terminal"))
  )

# --- 3. Mean and SE per grid_size x density x measure x phase ---------------
metrics_long_stats <- metrics_long_raw %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, measure, phase) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 4. Plot: bars + SE error bars + jittered raw points --------------------
p2 <- ggplot(metrics_long_stats, aes(x = phase, y = mean_val, fill = density)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = metrics_long_raw,
    aes(x = phase, y = value, fill = density),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.1, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(measure ~ grid_size) +
  labs(
    # title = "Accuracy, Entropy, JSD, and Optimal Entropy by Phase, Grid Size, and Density",
    x = "Phase",
    y = "Value",
    fill = "Density"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3594cc", "#8cc5e3", "#ea801c", "#f0b077")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

p2 
ggsave(
  file.path("figures", file_output, "accuracy_entropy_jsd.png"),
  p2, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 600
)
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Task success at the grid level --------------------------------------
success_raw <- traj_df %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, reasoning_effort, grid_key) %>%
  summarise(value = mean(coin_and_goal), .groups = "drop") %>%
  select(-grid_key) %>%
  mutate(measure = "Task success")

# --- 2. Grid-level metrics ---------------------------------------------------
metrics_raw <- grid_df %>%
  rename(
    Accuracy = mean_action_accuracy,
    Entropy  = mean_entropy,
    JSD      = mean_jsd
  ) %>%
  select(grid_size, density, reasoning_effort, Accuracy, Entropy, JSD) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Accuracy, Entropy, JSD),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  )

# --- 3. Bind and harmonise factors ------------------------------------------
combined_raw <- bind_rows(success_raw, metrics_raw) %>%
  mutate(
    grid_size        = factor(grid_size),
    density          = factor(density),
    reasoning_effort = factor(reasoning_effort,
                              levels = c("low", "medium", "random"),
                              labels = c("Low", "Medium", "Random")),
    measure          = factor(measure,
                              levels = c("Task success", "Accuracy", "Entropy", "JSD"))
  )

combined_stats <- combined_raw %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, reasoning_effort, measure) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val   = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(value))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 4. Plot -----------------------------------------------------------------
p2_1 <- ggplot(combined_stats,
             aes(x = reasoning_effort, y = mean_val, fill = density)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = combined_raw,
    aes(x = reasoning_effort, y = value, fill = density),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.2, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(measure ~ grid_size, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3594cc", "#8cc5e3", "#ea801c", "#f0b077")) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Value", fill = "Density") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

p2_1

ggsave(
  file.path("figures", file_output, "combined_metrics1.png"),
  p2_1, width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 800
)
```

# Accuracy statistical tests

```{r}
acc_df <- traj_df %>%
  mutate(reasoning_effort = relevel(factor(reasoning_effort), ref = "random"))


accuracy_mdl1 <- lmer(
  action_accuracy ~ reasoning_effort + grid_size + density + (1 | grid_key),
  data = acc_df,
  control= lmerControl(optimizer='bobyqa')
)
summary(accuracy_mdl1)

parameters::model_parameters(accuracy_mdl1, ci_method = "kr")
```

# Movement 

## Cardinal actions  

```{r}
# --- 1. Reshape action counts to long format ---------------------------------
actions_long_raw <- traj_df %>%
  # filter(coin_and_goal == 1) %>%
  select(reasoning_effort, grid_size, density,
         num_actions_up, num_actions_down, num_actions_left, num_actions_right) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("num_actions_"),
    names_to = "action",
    names_prefix = "num_actions_",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    action = factor(action, levels = c("up", "down", "left", "right"),
                     labels = c("Up", "Down", "Left", "Right"))
  )

# --- 2. Mean and SE per reasoning_effort x grid_size x density x action -------------------------
actions_long_stats <- actions_long_raw %>%
  group_by(reasoning_effort, grid_size, density, action) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_count   = sd(count, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(count))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 3. Plot A: raw counts — bars + SE error bars + jittered raw points -----
p4 <- ggplot(actions_long_stats, aes(x = action, y = mean_count, fill = density)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7, alpha = 0.8,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_count - se_count, ymax = mean_count + se_count),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = actions_long_raw,
    aes(x = action, y = count, fill = density),
    position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8),
    size = 0.8, alpha = 0.015, shape = 16, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_grid(reasoning_effort ~ grid_size) +
  labs(
    # title = "Mean Cardinal Action Counts by Grid Size and Density",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Density"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3594cc", "#8cc5e3", "#ea801c", "#f0b077")) +
  theme_bw() +

    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

p4
```

```{r}
# --- 4. Plot B: proportions — stacked bars ------------------------------------
# Compute each trajectory's own action proportions first, then average within group
actions_prop_raw <- full_data %>%
  select(grid_size, density,
         num_actions_up, num_actions_down, num_actions_left, num_actions_right) %>%
  mutate(total = num_actions_up + num_actions_down + num_actions_left + num_actions_right) %>%
  filter(total > 0) %>%   # drop trajectories with zero actions to avoid div-by-zero
  mutate(
    prop_up    = num_actions_up    / total,
    prop_down  = num_actions_down  / total,
    prop_left  = num_actions_left  / total,
    prop_right = num_actions_right / total
  ) %>%
  select(grid_size, density, starts_with("prop_")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("prop_"),
    names_to = "action",
    names_prefix = "prop_",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    action = factor(action, levels = c("up", "down", "left", "right"),
                     labels = c("Up", "Down", "Left", "Right"))
  )

actions_prop_stats <- actions_prop_raw %>%
  group_by(grid_size, density, action) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(proportion, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(actions_prop_stats, aes(x = density, y = mean_prop, fill = action)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7, alpha = 0.9,
           colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ grid_size, labeller = label_both) +
  labs(
    title = "Mean Cardinal Action Proportions by Grid Size and Density",
    x = "Density",
    y = "Proportion",
    fill = "Action"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3594cc", "#8cc5e3", "#ea801c", "#f0b077")) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
direction_long <- traj_df %>%
  mutate(
    traj_uid = interaction(grid_key, trajectory_id, drop = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(c("num_actions_up", "num_actions_down",
                "num_actions_left", "num_actions_right")),
    names_to = "direction",
    names_prefix = "num_actions_",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = factor(direction),
    reasoning_effort = relevel(factor(reasoning_effort), ref = "random")
    ) %>%
  select(reasoning_effort, count, direction, grid_size, density, trajectory_length, traj_uid, grid_key)


action_null <- glmer(count ~ offset(log(trajectory_length))
            + (direction | grid_key),
            family = poisson, data = filter(direction_long, !reasoning_effort %in% c("random", "medium")))

action_mdl1 <- glmer(count ~ direction
            + offset(log(trajectory_length))
            + (direction | grid_key),
            family = poisson, data = filter(direction_long, !reasoning_effort %in% c("random", "medium")))

anova(action_null, action_mdl1)

model_parameters(action_mdl1)
```

```{r}
action_mdl2 <- glmer(count ~ direction * reasoning_effort
            + offset(log(trajectory_length))
            + (direction | grid_key),
            family = poisson, data = direction_long)

model_parameters(action_mdl2)
```

```{r}
# --- 1. Reshape to long format, keeping every raw row (for jitter) ----------
quadrant_long_raw <- traj_df %>%
  filter(reasoning_effort == "medium") %>%
  mutate(
    grid_size = factor(grid_size),
    density   = factor(density)
  ) %>%
  select(grid_size, density, grid_key,
         quadrant_fraction_ul, quadrant_fraction_ur,
         quadrant_fraction_dl, quadrant_fraction_dr) %>%
  pivot_longer(

    names_to = "quadrant",
    names_prefix = "quadrant_fraction_",

  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quadrant = factor(quadrant,
                       levels = c("ul", "ur", "dl", "dr"),
                       labels = c("Upper Left", "Upper Right", "Lower Left", "Lower Right"))
  )

  group_by(grid_size, density, quadrant) %>%
```

```{r}
quadrant_long <- traj_df %>%
  mutate(
    traj_uid = interaction(grid_key, trajectory_id, drop = TRUE),
    quadrant_sum = quadrant_count_ul + quadrant_count_ur + quadrant_count_dl + quadrant_count_dr
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(c("quadrant_count_ul", "quadrant_count_ur",
                "quadrant_count_dl", "quadrant_count_dr")),
    names_to = "quadrant",
    names_prefix = "quadrant_count_",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    quadrant = relevel(factor(quadrant), ref = "ur"),
    reasoning_effort = relevel(factor(reasoning_effort), ref = "random"),
    has_coin = quadrant == coin_quadrant,
    has_terminal = quadrant == terminal_quadrant
    ) %>%
  select(reasoning_effort, count, quadrant, grid_size, density, quadrant_sum, traj_uid, grid_key, coin_quadrant, has_coin, terminal_quadrant, has_terminal) %>%
  filter(!quadrant_sum == 0) # Removing quadrant_sum == 0 so that log (0) is NA 
```

```{r}
quadrant_null <- glmer(count ~ offset(log(quadrant_sum)) 
                       + has_coin + has_terminal
                       + (quadrant | grid_key),
                       family = poisson, data = filter(quadrant_long, reasoning_effort == "low"))

quadrant_mdl1 <- glmer(count ~ quadrant
                       + has_coin + has_terminal
                       + offset(log(quadrant_sum))
                       + (quadrant | grid_key),
                       family = poisson, data = filter(quadrant_long, reasoning_effort == "low"))

anova(quadrant_null, quadrant_mdl1)
model_parameters(quadrant_mdl1)
```

```{r}
quadrant_mdl2 <- glmer(count ~ reasoning_effort * quadrant + has_coin + has_terminal
            + offset(log(quadrant_sum))
            + (quadrant | grid_key),
            family = poisson, data = quadrant_long)
model_parameters(quadrant_mdl2)
```
